tooltip.jaymospowers.runic_amulet: Carried, or worn as an amulet bauble, it slowly draws the fleeting taint from you.
message.jaymospowers.infusion.no_pedesta: The stone hangs over nothing that can bear it.
message.jaymospowers.infusion.not_unders: You do not yet understand this working.
message.jaymospowers.infusion.dry: The stone thirsts; the jars run dry.
message.jaymospowers.infusion.lacking: The stone waits on something it was promised.
message.jaymospowers.infusion.lost: The working falters and is lost.
message.jaymospowers.infusion.blast: The stone cracks open and the working is undone!
message.jaymospowers.infusion.mood.calm: The stone hums, low and even.
message.jaymospowers.infusion.mood.uneas: The stone hums, and not quite evenly.
message.jaymospowers.infusion.mood.restl: The stone shudders in the air.
message.jaymospowers.infusion.mood.wild: The stone shrieks; the air bites.
research.jaymospowers.infusion.text: A stone pillar to hold a thing, and a runed stone hung two paces above it. Ring the pillar with more pillars, each bearing a part of the work, touch the stone with a phial of essence, and the stone will draw essence from the jars about it, take the parts from their pillars one by one, and remake the thing in the middle. Keep jars near, and be careful what you ask of it.
research.jaymospowers.stability.text: The stone dislikes lopsided company: a part with no twin across the middle unsettles it. Set the parts in pairs. Salt candles, skulls and ward stones about the altar quiet it. A restless stone throws parts from their pillars, stings those near, spills flux, and at the last bursts.
research.jaymospowers.ichor.text: A diamond, the tears of a ghast and the rose metal, bathed in spirit, arcana and light, becomes a bright liquid-gold that clings to the hand. Good for gear that wants more than iron or netherite can give.
research.jaymospowers.runic_amulet.text: A gold ingot infused with the rose metal and a pinch of salt, steeped in spirit and salt. Carried about, it quietly draws off the fleeting taint that clings to those who work with flux.
research.jaymospowers.infused_enchanting: An enchanted thing in the middle, four lapis lazuli, two ingots of the rose metal and a book that holds an enchantment the thing already bears at its fullest. The stone raises that enchantment one level beyond what any table can grant. It is a loud and unruly working, and it leaves much flux behind.
